name: Liver Ultrasound Tracking Benchmark (2014)
description: A benchmark dataset and evaluation suite for tracking liver motion and anatomical structures in ultrasound video sequences.
evaluation_method: mean Euclidean tracking error (mm), success rate within distance thresholds, and IoU/Dice for tracked regions
reputation: A moderately used 2014 reference dataset in medical image registration/tracking research for liver ultrasound, though less ubiquitous than CT/MRI benchmarks.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; ultrasound-specific artifacts (speckle, shadowing) and typically limited dataset size can hinder generalization; temporal continuity must be handled.
